# Repository Instructions

Follow the canonical repository guidance in `AGENTS.md` before changing code. Use task-specific workflows from `.agents/skills/`, including `working-with-convex`, `working-with-plans`, and `agent-browser` when their descriptions match the task.

Do not read `.env*` or secrets, edit generated files, weaken tests, or treat local plan files as authoritative issue status. Linear is the source of truth for work state and priority.
